paragraphs.text:
You  raise  a  torch  to  illuminate  the  body  on  the  floor  of 
the  cave.  It  is  a  man-ape  of  incredible  musculature.  Your 
examination satisfies you that this must be what northern 
legend calls a sasquatch. You have the physical evidence here 
to prove your discovery.

If you take the sasquatch head as a specimen, record the keyword 
STOCKHOUSE. Then, go to 513.
